violations.description: General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. Particle board cabinets/shelving at FOH coffee bar showing water damage.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Upright 2 door cooler in BOH area has dried spilled milk inside and needs cleaning.

Mechanical cleaning and sanitizing requirements. — --Sanitize solution for mechanical ware washing machine was not maintained at the proper concentration. 3 chemicals connected to under-counter dish machine at 3 compartment sink system. Rinse water not indicating chlorine when tested. (data plate indicates high temperature sanitizing)--Surface of equipment/utensil did not reach minimum temperature of 160F during hot water sanitize rinse of ware wash machine. Under counter dish machine near 3 compartment sink not reaching proper temperature according to gauge/indicator on machine. (data plate indicates high temperature sanitizing)--Ware wash machine was not maintained and/or operated as required. Service dish machine as needed.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Floors under equipment have a build up of dust/debris and need cleaning.

General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. Particle board cabinets at FOH service counter have areas of water swelling/damage.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. FOH service counter cabinets need cleaning.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Floors under equipment in FOH and BOH areas have a buildup of debris and need cleaning.
